questions.explanation: Total girls in row $= 14\text{ (left)} + 1\text{ (Sheetal)} + 3\text{ (between)} + 1\text{ (Sapna)} + 9\text{ (right)} = 28$.
Displacement is equal to the area under the velocity-time graph. Area of triangle $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 2 \times 4 = 4\text{ m}$.
An object at a larger distance from the mirror subtends a narrower angle past the visual obstruction and disappears first (Object R).
Ice at $0^\circ\text{C}$ absorbs latent heat of fusion to melt into water at $0^\circ\text{C}$. Temperature remains constant while thermal energy works to break intermolecular bonds.

Ray bends towards the normal when passing from medium 1 to medium 2, indicating $\mu_2 > \mu_1$. Total internal reflection only occurs when entering an optically rarer medium ($"\sin i > \sin C"$), which is impossible at point R, meaning no TIR occurs at R.

Ball rolling down an incline accelerates under gravity, so velocity increases continuously. Upon reaching the horizontal frictionless track, net horizontal force is zero, so velocity remains constant (horizontal line in Graph B).
An electromagnet is an artificial temporary magnet created by winding an insulated copper wire coil around a soft iron core. It loses magnetism as soon as the electric current stops.
Parallel incident rays converge after reflection from a concave mirror and diverge from a convex mirror. Only a flat plane mirror reflects parallel incident rays as a parallel beam.
Distance is the actual path length traversed, whereas displacement is the straight-line shortest vector from initial to final position.
If a compass needle experiences zero net torque/deflection, the surrounding poles are symmetrically aligned.
A tropical cyclone acts as an atmospheric thermal engine fueled by latent heat of condensation. The central calm region of lowest barometric pressure is termed the 'eye'.
$2\text{Mg} + \text{O}_2 \to 2\text{MgO}$. Dissolved in water: $\text{MgO} + \text{H}_2\text{O} \to \text{Mg(OH)}_2$. Magnesium hydroxide is basic, turning red litmus blue and phenolphthalein pink.

Centrifugation separates blood cells from plasma; evaporation crystallizes dissolved salt; magnetic separation extracts iron filings; a separating funnel separates immiscible liquids (petrol and water).
China rose indicator turns dark pink in acids (orange juice, vinegar), green in bases (slaked lime $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$), and shows no colour change in neutral solutions (glucose).
Honey and mustard oil are edible lipids/carbohydrates; copper and gold are elemental transition metals.
Handpicking stones from rice is physical and reversible. Curdling of milk is chemical and irreversible. Breaking a flower vase is physical and irreversible.

$\text{SO}_2$ is a non-metallic oxide. When dissolved in water, it forms sulphurous acid: $\text{SO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \to \text{H}_2\text{SO}_3$. Acids turn China rose indicator dark pink (magenta).

Reaction of vinegar with baking soda releases $\text{CO}_2$ gas: $\text{CH}_3\text{COOH} + \text{NaHCO}_3 \to \text{CH}_3\text{COONa} + \text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{CO}_2\uparrow$. Iron in copper sulphate undergoes single displacement: $\text{Fe} + \text{CuSO}_4 \to \text{FeSO}_4 + \text{Cu}\downarrow$ (blue solution turns green; brown copper deposits on nail).

Detergents are basic (turn red litmus blue). Aerated soft drinks contain carbonic acid (turn China rose magenta). Neutralisation reactions are universally exothermic (release heat). Window cleaners contain ammonium hydroxide $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ (turn phenolphthalein pink).
Cartilage is a firm, flexible connective tissue found in joints, the ear pinna, and the tip of the nose that cushions bone ends.
P: evaporation, Q: condensation, R: infiltration, S: precipitation, T: transpiration. Excess precipitation causes flooding; prolonged absence of precipitation causes severe drought.
*Paramecium* is covered with thousands of rhythmic microscopic hair-like cilia used for locomotion and sweeping food particles into its oral groove.
Stigma, style, and ovary constitute the pistil/carpel (female organ). Anther and filament form the stamen (male organ). Maize and cucumber bear unisexual flowers; mustard bears bisexual flowers.
X (non-flowering cryptogam, e.g., moss); Y (reproduces vegetatively via foliar buds, e.g., *Bryophyllum*); Z (seed-bearing angiosperm, e.g., maize).
Matches biological structures and functions accurately: P-(iii), Q-(i), R-(iv), S-(ii).
Natural fibres are derived from plant sources (cotton, jute), animal sources (wool, silk), or mineral sources (asbestos).
Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness. Vitamin $B_3$ (niacin) deficiency causes pellagra. Iodine deficiency causes goitre (enlarged thyroid).
Vegetable peels are organic and biodegradable (compostable). Ceramic bowls are non-biodegradable and cannot be composted. Jute is a natural biodegradable fibre.

Phloem translocates photosynthetic carbohydrates (sucrose) bidirectional throughout plants. Anaemia is characterized by insufficient hemoglobin or red blood cells. Normal blood contains roughly $5 \times 10^6$ RBCs per $\text{mm}^3$, vastly outnumbering WBCs ($6000-8000$ per $\text{mm}^3$).
Plants breathe through stomata in leaves, lenticels in woody bark, and general root hair surfaces in soil.

Chlorophyll traps solar radiation for photosynthesis. Mushrooms are heterotrophic saprophytic fungi. Ingestion is the intake of food; assimilation is incorporating absorbed nutrients into bodily tissues for growth and respiration.
Yaks have long thick fleece for thermal insulation, large hearts and lung capacities with high red blood cell counts to survive hypoxia, and broad cloven hooves to traverse snow.
Vegetative reproduction produces genetically identical clones, bypasses the vulnerable seedling phase for faster maturity, and propagates seedless varieties (banana, sugarcane).
Forests yield renewable economic timber, pharmaceutical herbal compounds, commercial resins, tannins, latex, and gums.
The kangaroo rat survives in arid deserts without drinking water by oxidizing dry seeds into metabolic water and concentrating urine via ultra-long loops of Henle.
Aerobic respiration stoichiometry: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 + 6\text{O}_2 \to 6\text{CO}_2 + 6\text{H}_2\text{O} + 36-38\text{ ATP (Energy)}$.

Region PQ shows heating of solid from $-5^\circ\text{C}$ to $0^\circ\text{C}$. Region QR shows the melting phase transition where temperature remains fixed at $0^\circ\text{C}$ while absorbing latent heat of fusion. Region RS shows heating of the liquid state.

Acetic acid reacts with sodium hydrogen carbonate: $\text{CH}_3\text{COOH} + \text{NaHCO}_3 \to \text{CH}_3\text{COONa} + \text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$. Passing $\text{CO}_2$ through clear limewater precipitates white calcium carbonate: $\text{Ca(OH)}_2 + \text{CO}_2 \to \text{CaCO}_3\downarrow + \text{H}_2\text{O}$.

Adult human dental formula: $\frac{2-1-2-3}{2-1-2-3}$. Incisors: 8 total (4 upper, 4 lower). Premolars: 8 total (4 upper, 4 lower). Canines: 4 total (2 upper, 2 lower). In the upper jaw: 4 incisors + 4 premolars + 2 canines $= 10$ teeth.
